newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies post limit gains in late trading.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies post limit gains in late trading.

text.p: CME pork belly futures sped to limit gains and contract highs in nearby months in reaction to firm cash pork belly prices and a slow buildup of warehouse supplies, traders said.

The early price gains in futures activated chart-based buying that lifted prices by the three-cent-per-lb daily limit, traders said. Commisson house E.D.&F. Man was featured buying May and July contracts during the late rise, traders said.
The CME weekly storage report Tuesday showed frozen bellies supplies decreased 409,000 lbs, while analysts had expected an increase of 250,000 to 500,000 lbs.
At 1251 CDT, pork bellies were up 3.00 to 1.40 cents with May up the limit at 92.825 cents and July up 3.00 cents at 92.075. Both prices were contract highs.
